edits.text: 火 is attested as a star name in Shang oracle-bone inscriptions and later in the Classic of Poetry. One account tentatively identifies it as 火星; other readings identify the referent as 大火, or 心宿二 (Antares). The evidence does not explain why the star was called 火.

The star-name use is distinct from the literal sense ‘fire’. One account tentatively identifies the star as 火星, while other readings identify it as 大火, or 心宿二 (Antares). The evidence does not explain why the star was called 火 or how its name relates to ‘fire’.
